dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep, smooth concave curvature (falcate) from the posterior basal insertion to the apex, fitting a parabolic spline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is characterized by a wide-radius rounded geometry; it is distinctly obtuse and non-tapered.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin presents a convex contour with an approximate 40-degree slope relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the maximum basal width of the fin to its vertical height is approximately 1.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The lateral surface of the dorsal fin and the visible dorsal ridge are covered in numerous small, white punctate markings and light-colored micro-scars.
